newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BLOCH NEARS INTERBRAND BUY, CHANGES NAME.
newsitem.headline: BLOCH NEARS INTERBRAND BUY, CHANGES NAME.

text.p: South Africa's Bloch Ltd said on Thursday that it was holding talks on buying unlisted Interbrand Ltd.
"A transaction is expected to be concluded shortly," the firm said in a brief statement.
Interbrand, which houses the Allied International Luggage and Papillon Group businesses, is involved in the distribution of luggage and handbags as well as promotional products.
Bloch also said that it aimed to focus its business on the distribution of branded consumer products and so would change its name to Brandcorp Holdings Ltd.
The firm added that was still in talks on a number of ongoing deals and advised shareholders to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
